messages.subject: mapQTL F2 dataset to R/qtl
parts:
Dear Prof Broman,

 

I am attempting to re-analyse a published dataset from a 10+ year old QTL study, in which the data files were formatted for and used in the MapQTL software. The study consists of a F2 breeding design, and I was hoping to use R/qtl to re-analyse the dataset, as I don’t have access to MapQTL. Following the examples in the manual, I attempted to run read.cross with format ‘mapqtl’, but I obtained an error that stated that ‘population type F2 is not supported’. I was wondering if this was rectified in an updated version of R/qtl. If not, I was wondering if there was a way to get around the error, maybe via re-formatting of files, in order to analyse the MapQTL formatted files.

 

Best,

Lenny

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] mapQTL F2 dataset to R/qtl
parts:
I just checked the code to read mapqtl. R/qtl currently only handles "4way" cross data in this format.
So you would need to separately re-arrange the data files into a different format before you could use them with R/qtl.

karl
